01a19af66815.en: Eori felt the hardness of the bony plate. Feels the same as when I did it on myself. Opening his mouth with her hand, she saw the bony plate open up, revealing a row of gills flushing with a mixture of venous and arterial blood—more of the venous side of things, though. She moved her head closer to the gills while moving Harry’s mouth towards the fost stone lamp. This allowed her to see the white light entering his mouth and lighting all the way into his trachea and out through the gills. Does look like what I expected.
01a19af66815.t: Eori merasakan kerasnya pelat tulang itu. Rasanya sama seperti waktu aku mencobanya pada diriku sendiri. Membuka mulut Harry dengan tangannya, ia melihat pelat tulang itu terbuka, memperlihatkan barisan insang yang memerah oleh campuran darah vena dan arteri—walaupun lebih ke sisi vena. Ia mendekatkan kepalanya ke insang itu sambil menggerakkan mulut Harry ke arah lampu fost stone. Ini memungkinkannya melihat cahaya putih masuk ke mulutnya dan menyinari sampai ke batang tenggorokannya lalu keluar melalui insang. Memang tampak seperti yang kuduga.

07395063a1ee.en: “Princess E-Eori?” Harry asked with a soft tone in his voice, holding a grounded nari stone in his palm. It had a bluish hue that glimmered magically—it looked like a ground-up version of a mana potion, at least for someone who didn’t know the scientific background and properties of nari.
07395063a1ee.t: “Putri E-Eori?” tanya Harry dengan nada lembut dalam suaranya, memegang batu nari yang sudah digiling di telapak tangannya. Warnanya biru yang berkilauan secara ajaib—tampak seperti versi giling dari ramuan mana, setidaknya bagi seseorang yang tidak tahu latar belakang ilmiah dan sifat-sifat nari.

0be81c4a53b9.en: A vivacious smile arose in Eori, feeling a happy tickle inside her innards as her mind couldn’t fathom how this concoction would perform. This is going to be fun! Eori tossed the journal at the table and pointed back at the grinder. “Go finish it! We’re experimenting shortly!” Eori’s hands were nearly moving on their own, grabbing mixing bowls from the walls and other utensils and laying them quickly on the table. There is something different about Harry—the growing list of strange words and the fact I failed to replicate his body hair are clear signs Gabiro did something. A single word loudly came out of her mouth, “FUCK!” She continued grabbing supplies for the experiment. I can’t believe I didn’t cross-check his baseline reaction before! That was fucking stupid of me! She grabbed another bowl. A vicious smile arose from ear to ear, feeling like a shot of pure exploratory energy was being injected into her veins. If he doesn’t perform baseline, then I will have an excuse to shift into completely exploratory research!
0be81c4a53b9.t: Senyum yang hidup muncul di wajah Eori, merasakan geli bahagia di dalam perutnya karena pikirannya tidak bisa membayangkan bagaimana ramuan ini akan bekerja. Ini bakal seru! Eori melempar jurnal itu ke meja dan menunjuk kembali ke alat penggiling. “Sana selesaikan! Sebentar lagi kita bereksperimen!” Tangan Eori hampir bergerak sendiri, mengambil mangkuk-mangkuk adonan dari dinding dan peralatan lainnya lalu meletakkannya dengan cepat di meja. Ada sesuatu yang berbeda tentang Harry—daftar kata-kata aneh yang terus bertambah dan kenyataan bahwa aku gagal meniru bulu tubuhnya adalah tanda-tanda jelas Gabiro melakukan sesuatu. Satu kata keluar dengan keras dari mulutnya, “BANGSAT!” Ia terus mengambil perlengkapan untuk eksperimen. Aku tidak percaya aku tidak memeriksa ulang reaksi dasarnya sebelumnya! Bodoh sekali aku, bangsat! Ia mengambil mangkuk lain. Senyum keji muncul dari telinga ke telinga, merasa seolah suntikan energi eksplorasi murni disuntikkan ke pembuluh darahnya. Kalau reaksinya tidak sesuai dasar, aku akan punya alasan untuk beralih ke penelitian eksploratif sepenuhnya!

0d9a3e2674bf.en: “Fungus. Best catalyst for lowering heart rate and reducing the urge to breathe,” Eori spoke after like she had memorized those words to heart.
0d9a3e2674bf.t: “Jamur. Katalis terbaik untuk menurunkan detak jantung dan mengurangi dorongan untuk bernapas,” kata Eori sesudahnya seolah ia sudah menghafal kata-kata itu di luar kepala.

0f58c4771e1a.en: “I—not—sure?” Harry spoke through his teeth. After a few seconds, he opened his eyes a bit. He squinted, looking at his own body, then relaxed and wiped the leftover nari gel from his mouth. “It—just—like when you’re sick with the flu?”
0f58c4771e1a.t: “Aku—tidak—yakin?” kata Harry melalui giginya. Setelah beberapa detik, ia sedikit membuka matanya. Ia menyipitkan mata, memandang tubuhnya sendiri, lalu santai dan menyeka sisa nari gel dari mulutnya. “Rasanya—seperti saat kau sakit flu?”

0faf0f56a1b0.en: “Fi-hi—fihi?” Harry’s tone seemed to grow worried as he kept on glancing at Eori’s straight face.
0faf0f56a1b0.t: “Fi-hi—fihi?” Nada Harry tampak semakin cemas sementara ia terus melirik wajah datar Eori.

15a876ec1735.en: “WHAT?” Eori snapped at Harry. Seeing the pile of ground-up nari offered to her, she walked up close and grabbed a bit with her fingers, rubbing them back and forth, checking the granularity. “Keep going. I need a dust-like appearance for nari gels.” She flicked his ear. “Don’t call me princess, you fuckwad! I’m a scientist.” She cleaned her fingers on his hair, leaving a dusty, shiny look. Princess my Sanbi ass. I never wanted that! She walked back to the morbid selection of gels, shuffling her purple hair out of her face.
15a876ec1735.t: “APA?” bentak Eori kepada Harry. Melihat tumpukan nari giling yang disodorkan kepadanya, ia berjalan mendekat dan mengambil sedikit dengan jari-jarinya, menggosoknya bolak-balik, memeriksa kehalusannya. “Lanjutkan. Aku butuh tampilan seperti debu untuk nari gel.” Ia menjentik telinga Harry. “Jangan panggil aku putri, dasar goblok! Aku ilmuwan.” Ia membersihkan jari-jarinya di rambut Harry, meninggalkan tampilan berdebu yang berkilau. Putri, pantat Sanbi-ku. Aku tidak pernah menginginkan itu! Ia berjalan kembali ke pilihan gel yang mengerikan, menyibakkan rambut ungunya dari wajahnya.

17aec14081a8.en: Harry came back to life with a groan and heavy twitching as his skin changed back to human, but this time it looked like he was shredded. His dehydrated skin was showing the finer details of all superficial muscles in his body, while the slime that was being spewed by his skin gave him a shiny look—he looked like an oiled strawweight fighter that pushed the boundaries of cutting water weight a bit too much.
17aec14081a8.t: Harry hidup kembali dengan erangan dan kedutan hebat saat kulitnya berubah kembali menjadi manusia, tetapi kali ini ia tampak sangat berotot kering. Kulitnya yang dehidrasi memperlihatkan detail-detail halus semua otot permukaan di tubuhnya, sementara lendir yang dikeluarkan kulitnya memberinya tampilan mengilap—ia tampak seperti petarung kelas jerami yang diminyaki yang terlalu memaksakan diri memangkas berat air.

18ab95dc8a23.en: Eori touched his chest again, pushing him back to the table. “Lie back down!”
18ab95dc8a23.t: Eori menyentuh dadanya lagi, mendorongnya kembali ke meja. “Berbaring lagi!”

1962729c7921.en: “Breathe faster! PANT! YES! Pant!” Eori kept tapping his chest.
1962729c7921.t: “Bernapas lebih cepat! TERENGAH! YA! Terengah!” Eori terus menepuk-nepuk dadanya.

1c809fdcf910.en: Eori nodded with a spoon in hand, picking a worm medallion with a blue carapace. “Exactly. No Breath Tier Two, for most people, means you can temporarily breathe underwater by sucking water through your mouth and pushing it out through your neck gills or by keeping your mouth open as you swim. You would still need to surface now and then to breathe air.” Waving her hands towards Harry’s neck, she continued spilling out things in a factual tone, “The gills are not big enough. If you go Tiers Three and Four, more gills appear on your back, and you can use your diaphragm to move water around, but you can’t breathe air anymore. Felt anything else?”
1c809fdcf910.t: Eori mengangguk dengan sendok di tangan, mengambil potongan cacing dengan cangkang biru. “Tepat. No Breath Tier Two, bagi kebanyakan orang, berarti kau bisa bernapas sementara di bawah air dengan mengisap air melalui mulut dan mendorongnya keluar melalui insang di leher atau dengan membiarkan mulutmu terbuka saat berenang. Kau tetap perlu naik ke permukaan sesekali untuk menghirup udara.” Melambaikan tangannya ke arah leher Harry, ia melanjutkan memaparkan berbagai hal dengan nada faktual, “Insangnya tidak cukup besar. Kalau kau naik ke Tier Three dan Four, lebih banyak insang muncul di punggungmu, dan kau bisa memakai diafragmamu untuk menggerakkan air, tapi kau tidak bisa lagi menghirup udara. Merasakan hal lain?”

1e05fcb7f007.en: She took her arm off the floor, looked, and smelled the droplets of a yellowish liquid dripping off her arm. Eww! I pissed myself! She sat on the basement floor, feeling more at home than back at Sanbi Castle. Mother will regret not giving me this earlier on!
1e05fcb7f007.t: Ia mengangkat lengannya dari lantai, memandang, dan mencium tetesan cairan kekuningan yang menetes dari lengannya. Iih! Aku mengompol! Ia duduk di lantai ruang bawah tanah, merasa lebih seperti di rumah daripada di Kastil Sanbi. Ibu akan menyesal tidak memberiku ini lebih awal!

208e8cda2e95.en: “I didn’t feel the urge to breathe?” Harry rubbed his chest. “My lungs feel normal now, but they felt like—I had inhaled smoke? It—hurt to breath.”
208e8cda2e95.t: “Aku tidak merasakan dorongan untuk bernapas?” Harry menggosok dadanya. “Paru-paruku terasa normal sekarang, tapi tadi rasanya seperti—aku menghirup asap? Rasanya—sakit untuk bernapas.”

27f6fd59bb3a.en: “Scientist Eori, I’m sorry—” Harry placed his shackled hands up midway in the air, not appearing to defend himself, but more like surrendering.
27f6fd59bb3a.t: “Ilmuwan Eori, maafkan aku—” Harry mengangkat tangannya yang dibelenggu setengah jalan ke udara, tampaknya bukan untuk membela diri, melainkan lebih seperti menyerah.

2c184efa780d.en: Vol 2 Chapter IV subchapter 5: the purple-haired woman holds a book in a storeroom full of jars, with Harry seated at the back.
2c184efa780d.t: Jilid 2 Bab IV subbab 5: wanita berambut ungu memegang buku di gudang penuh toples, dengan Harry duduk di belakang.

2d0d7eb1181c.en: Eori chewed her fingernail, looking back at her journal. Her eyes kept reading, searching for something interesting, eventually finding one. Reintroduce or maintain the natural breathing reflex without affecting the urge to breathe? Eori looked at the macabre wall for an answer. Fuck. I forgot to research—
2d0d7eb1181c.t: Eori menggigit kukunya, kembali memandang jurnalnya. Matanya terus membaca, mencari sesuatu yang menarik, akhirnya menemukannya. Memperkenalkan kembali atau mempertahankan refleks bernapas alami tanpa memengaruhi dorongan untuk bernapas? Eori memandang dinding mengerikan itu mencari jawaban. Bangsat. Aku lupa meneliti—

2d3d297c7100.en: “Frog? What the fuck?” Eori stared at Harry with perplexed pink irises, then took her journal back swiftly. “Are you that fucking stupid?” Eori tapped the name on the page, nearly shoving the journal in his face. “No Breath means we’re tampering with the lungs! NOT THE SKIN!” Eori raised the journal above her head, gathering strength to strike Harry across the face—with part of her brain delaying the punishment as she felt a good tickle from seeing how growingly domesticated he had become. With her nose high in the air like a snooty celebrity, she said blatantly, “Anything else stupid to say? Huh?”
2d3d297c7100.t: “Katak? Apa-apaan, bangsat?” Eori menatap Harry dengan iris merah muda yang bingung, lalu cepat-cepat mengambil kembali jurnalnya. “Kau sebodoh itu, bangsat?” Eori mengetuk nama di halaman itu, hampir menjejalkan jurnal itu ke wajahnya. “No Breath berarti kita mengutak-atik paru-paru! BUKAN KULIT!” Eori mengangkat jurnal itu di atas kepalanya, mengumpulkan tenaga untuk memukul wajah Harry—dengan sebagian otaknya menunda hukuman itu karena ia merasakan geli yang menyenangkan melihat betapa semakin jinaknya Harry. Dengan hidung terangkat tinggi seperti selebritas sombong, ia berkata terang-terangan, “Ada hal bodoh lain yang mau kau katakan? Hah?”

2e9c76f38906.en: With mischievous laughter, Eori rubbed her finger down Harry’s chest and stomach, picking up slime along the way. “Are you still itchy?” She checked the consistency of the slime running down her finger, growing colder and thicker as she played with it.
2e9c76f38906.t: Dengan tawa nakal, Eori menggosokkan jarinya ke bawah dada dan perut Harry, mengambil lendir di sepanjang jalan. “Kau masih gatal?” Ia memeriksa kekentalan lendir yang mengalir di jarinya, yang semakin dingin dan kental saat ia memainkannya.

310c271bc06d.en: “Like—it lives on soil. It’s like a stringy thingy that wiggles around? No head or feet—I—used it to fish with? I-I think?” Harry kept looking down, speaking inwardly. “Did I ever fish?” slipped out at the end, sounding like a loud thought.
310c271bc06d.t: “Seperti—hidup di tanah. Seperti benda panjang berserat yang menggeliat-geliat? Tidak punya kepala atau kaki—aku—memakainya untuk memancing? A-aku rasa?” Harry terus menunduk, berbicara ke dalam. “Apa aku pernah memancing?” lolos di akhir, terdengar seperti pikiran yang terucap keras.

33b6f87c2199.en: “SAY IT!” Eori struck the journal on his head with a vertical swing but didn’t convert all the potential energy into kinetic—making a soft thud sound instead of a loud smack.
33b6f87c2199.t: “KATAKAN!” Eori memukulkan jurnal itu ke kepalanya dengan ayunan vertikal tetapi tidak mengubah seluruh energi potensialnya menjadi kinetik—menimbulkan bunyi debuk pelan alih-alih tamparan keras.

347b8aab4c54.en: Skin breathing? Eori paused; her ears didn’t believe what she had precisely heard. An annoyance within her began transforming into a scientific curiosity. She lowered her journal. “Explain yourself.”
347b8aab4c54.t: Bernapas lewat kulit? Eori terdiam; telinganya tidak percaya apa yang baru saja ia dengar dengan tepat. Rasa jengkel di dalam dirinya mulai berubah menjadi rasa ingin tahu ilmiah. Ia menurunkan jurnalnya. “Jelaskan.”

3957035a05d4.en: The inherited walking heart colors can’t be enough to interfere with it. Eori fed him another spoonful, this time containing a red-carapace worm because her hands could not hold back waiting for the complete Tier I transformation. “How about now?” She observed Harry grunting even more as his skin turned reddish brown, pouring thick sweat through every pore of his skin. She touched the sweat, feeling its sliminess similar to the consistency of a dog slobber. “Oh! It’s slimy already!”
3957035a05d4.t: Warna walking heart yang diwariskan tidak mungkin cukup untuk mengganggunya. Eori menyuapinya satu sendok lagi, kali ini berisi cacing bercangkang merah karena tangannya tidak bisa menahan diri menunggu transformasi Tier I yang lengkap. “Bagaimana sekarang?” Ia mengamati Harry yang semakin mendengus sementara kulitnya berubah menjadi cokelat kemerahan, mengucurkan keringat kental dari setiap pori kulitnya. Ia menyentuh keringat itu, merasakan kelicinannya yang mirip konsistensi air liur anjing. “Oh! Sudah berlendir!”

3e4a357b4391.en: Chapter VI – Lab Passion · Vol 2 - Lab Soreno · #HusbandOutWorld
3e4a357b4391.t: Bab VI – Gairah Lab · Jilid 2 - Soreno Percobaan · #HusbandOutWorld

4118996f4832.en: Eori sighed. “It’s fucking simple! Press your tongue on the roof of your mouth, then slide it backward. Now breathe in through your nose!”
4118996f4832.t: Eori menghela napas. “Gampang sekali, bangsat! Tekan lidahmu ke langit-langit mulut, lalu geser ke belakang. Sekarang tarik napas lewat hidung!”

414b62b08c3c.en: Which direction should I research first? Eori looked at her notes, seeing several possible directions written down, then kept on looking around at the wall of macabre jars, seeing if anything else tickled her scientific curiosity. For cost reduction, barina lungs are already the cheapest amphibian lung I can get. Gills, too—which leaves a fungi replacement for lakata. Tyr is quite similar and would reduce the cost by a whole pearl per five nari gels—but I have no fucking idea how to counterbalance the hallucinations. Eori grabbed a jar off the wall and glanced at it closer. The brownish water revealed mushroom slices floating around alongside tiny golden-yellow globules resembling tapioca pearls. Tyr does not reduce heart rate—what if I try reducing or mixing ratios and check if that has a one-to-one relation with potencies? She placed the jar on the table.
414b62b08c3c.t: Arah mana yang harus kuteliti lebih dulu? Eori memandang catatannya, melihat beberapa kemungkinan arah yang tertulis, lalu terus memandang sekeliling dinding toples-toples mengerikan, melihat apakah ada hal lain yang menggelitik rasa ingin tahu ilmiahnya. Untuk pengurangan biaya, paru-paru barina sudah paru-paru amfibi termurah yang bisa kudapat. Insang juga—yang menyisakan pengganti jamur untuk lakata. Tyr cukup mirip dan akan mengurangi biaya satu pearl penuh per lima nari gel—tapi aku sama sekali tidak tahu, bangsat, bagaimana mengimbangi halusinasinya. Eori mengambil sebuah toples dari dinding dan memeriksanya lebih dekat. Air kecokelatan itu memperlihatkan irisan-irisan jamur yang mengapung bersama butiran-butiran kecil kuning keemasan yang mirip mutiara tapioka. Tyr tidak menurunkan detak jantung—bagaimana kalau aku mencoba mengurangi atau mencampur rasio dan memeriksa apakah itu punya hubungan satu banding satu dengan potensinya? Ia meletakkan toples itu di meja.

41ffe614d5ef.en: Meanwhile, Harry seemed to strain as he tried to gain momentum moving the heavy grinder, but he immediately stopped when hearing Eori’s voice. Squinting at the journal she was waving towards him, he stood up and walked towards her, making metallic rustling noises with his shackles. Grabbing the journal with both hands, like he were receiving some sort of precious artifact, he glued the pages to his face, slowly glancing over the masterfully done handwriting that nearly looked like it came from a printer instead. “L—lakata?”
41ffe614d5ef.t: Sementara itu, Harry tampak mengerahkan tenaga saat mencoba mendapatkan momentum untuk menggerakkan alat penggiling yang berat itu, tetapi ia segera berhenti saat mendengar suara Eori. Menyipitkan mata ke arah jurnal yang dikibaskan Eori ke arahnya, ia berdiri dan berjalan ke arahnya, menimbulkan bunyi gemerincing logam dengan belenggunya. Mengambil jurnal itu dengan kedua tangan, seolah ia menerima semacam artefak berharga, ia menempelkan halaman-halamannya ke wajahnya, perlahan melirik tulisan tangan yang dibuat dengan begitu ahli sampai hampir tampak seperti keluar dari mesin cetak. “L—lakata?”

46b89a2fdc2c.en: Seeing images of herself stuck in back-to-back mentor classes, going from boring-ass in-depth lectures of kingdom history to grandiose life stories of past and current people in power, Eori shook her head, trying to flush away those vivid life-draining memories. She will listen to me when I rake in enough balls to fill the kingdom coffers—
46b89a2fdc2c.t: Melihat bayangan dirinya terjebak dalam kelas-kelas mentor yang berturut-turut, mulai dari kuliah mendalam yang membosankan setengah mati tentang sejarah kerajaan sampai kisah hidup megah orang-orang berkuasa di masa lalu dan sekarang, Eori menggeleng, berusaha membuang ingatan-ingatan yang begitu nyata dan menguras jiwa itu. Dia akan mendengarkanku kalau aku sudah meraup cukup banyak bola untuk mengisi kas kerajaan—

4ba508d9782e.en: “Now, breathe in and out through your nose!” Eori closed his mouth tightly.
4ba508d9782e.t: “Sekarang, tarik dan embuskan napas lewat hidungmu!” Eori menutup mulut Harry rapat-rapat.

4d1bfddea382.en: Harry contained the gag reflex, seemingly trying to relax instead. His whole upper body recoiled as another gag came, but with a huge gulp, he looked to have powered through it. His face tightened even more, and his knuckles were white as he groaned from his nose, perhaps preparing for the worst.
4d1bfddea382.t: Harry menahan refleks muntahnya, tampaknya malah mencoba santai. Seluruh tubuh bagian atasnya tersentak mundur saat rasa mual lain datang, tetapi dengan tegukan besar, ia tampaknya berhasil melewatinya. Wajahnya semakin mengencang, dan buku-buku jarinya memutih saat ia mengerang lewat hidungnya, mungkin bersiap untuk yang terburuk.

4f27f17822eb.en: Eori felt his constant heart rhythm, mostly unchanged from before he drew breath. Removal of the urge to breathe is baseline too. Eori kept looking at Harry, observing his subservient mood. “Keep holding!” She placed her hand on his warm, hairy chest. Why can’t I figure this shit out? Or does this directly correlate to the Buhraies spell Gabiro used? Eori subconsciously fiddled with his body hair, also feeling his rib cage texturizing his weakening muscles. She looked at the tiny timehunk sandglass, still away from its midpoint time-counting capabilities. Any moment now! She saw his eyes slowly growing distant while his chest still wasn’t moving up or down, just like she told him to do. He might break the baseline on this metric—
4f27f17822eb.t: Eori merasakan irama jantungnya yang konstan, sebagian besar tidak berubah dari sebelum ia menarik napas. Hilangnya dorongan untuk bernapas juga sesuai dasar. Eori terus memandang Harry, mengamati suasana hatinya yang patuh. “Terus tahan!” Ia meletakkan tangannya di dada Harry yang hangat dan berbulu. Kenapa aku tidak bisa memahami urusan sialan ini? Atau apa ini berhubungan langsung dengan mantra Buhraies yang dipakai Gabiro? Eori tanpa sadar memainkan bulu tubuhnya, juga merasakan tulang rusuknya memberi tekstur pada otot-ototnya yang melemah. Ia memandang jam pasir timehunk yang mungil itu, yang masih belum mencapai titik tengah kemampuannya menghitung waktu. Sebentar lagi! Ia melihat matanya perlahan semakin menerawang sementara dadanya masih tidak bergerak naik atau turun, persis seperti yang ia suruh. Dia mungkin akan melampaui dasar pada metrik ini—

4fceafa608f8.en: “I’m sorry, scientist Eori,” Harry quietly stated, carefully emptying his hand back into the grinder.
4fceafa608f8.t: “Maafkan aku, ilmuwan Eori,” kata Harry pelan, dengan hati-hati mengosongkan tangannya kembali ke alat penggiling.

518c912aabc1.en: Meanwhile, Harry seemed to have some slight smile going on, but he didn’t seem capable of doing anything else. “W—ater—” A noise in the form of a word came out of him, sounding like he was tethering between life and death.
518c912aabc1.t: Sementara itu, Harry tampaknya sedikit tersenyum, tetapi ia tampaknya tidak mampu melakukan hal lain. “A—ir—” Bunyi berbentuk kata keluar darinya, terdengar seolah ia terombang-ambing antara hidup dan mati.

51b72f596c68.en: Meanwhile, grinding noises kept filling the background. It was Harry, shackled at hands and feet, grinding away nari stones. He silently glanced over at Eori, picking three macabre-looking jars and placing them on the table; two were filled with a blood-red gel-like substance with something fleshy inside, while the other was slightly blackish, filled with something fibrous-looking.
51b72f596c68.t: Sementara itu, bunyi menggiling terus memenuhi latar belakang. Itu Harry, dibelenggu di tangan dan kaki, menggiling batu-batu nari. Ia diam-diam melirik Eori, yang mengambil tiga toples yang tampak mengerikan dan meletakkannya di meja; dua terisi zat mirip gel berwarna merah darah dengan sesuatu yang berdaging di dalamnya, sementara yang lain agak kehitaman, berisi sesuatu yang tampak berserat.

5421eec532a3.en: “E-Eori?” Harry subserviently asked, his voice strained as he seemed to put his body weight to stop the hefty grinder.
5421eec532a3.t: “E-Eori?” tanya Harry dengan patuh, suaranya tegang karena ia tampak mengerahkan berat badannya untuk menghentikan alat penggiling yang berat itu.

54eeb14bad3c.en: Breaking away from her mission, Eori flipped her journal to a specific page, and appended more translations at the end. Frogs = Barina. Earthworms = Culuim. Looking around through the macabre jars again, her eyes were on the hunt for something akin to that. “So you’re saying something like culuim?” Eori pulled out a jar filled with the usual blood-soaked gel, but this time it contained diced worm medallions about three times as thick as regular earthworms. The reddish brown flesh looked similar, but it had a sort of a carapace, or more like a thicker skin on its top—if that could be considered the top. The carapace-like skin of these worms looked deflated, with an empty space in the middle—looking like it could puff up with blood if they were alive. They also came in a few colors: red, yellow, blue, green, or purple. To the naked eye, this macabre jar had a strange candy-like vibe.
54eeb14bad3c.t: Menghentikan misinya, Eori membalik jurnalnya ke halaman tertentu, dan menambahkan lebih banyak terjemahan di akhir. Katak = Barina. Cacing tanah = Culuim. Memandang sekeliling toples-toples mengerikan lagi, matanya berburu sesuatu yang mirip itu. “Jadi maksudmu sesuatu seperti culuim?” Eori mengeluarkan sebuah toples berisi gel yang basah oleh darah seperti biasa, tetapi kali ini berisi potongan-potongan cacing berbentuk medali yang kira-kira tiga kali lebih tebal daripada cacing tanah biasa. Daging cokelat kemerahannya tampak serupa, tetapi punya semacam cangkang, atau lebih seperti kulit yang lebih tebal di bagian atasnya—kalau itu bisa dianggap bagian atas. Kulit mirip cangkang cacing-cacing ini tampak kempis, dengan ruang kosong di tengahnya—tampak seperti bisa menggembung berisi darah kalau mereka masih hidup. Mereka juga punya beberapa warna: merah, kuning, biru, hijau, atau ungu. Bagi mata telanjang, toples mengerikan ini punya aura aneh seperti permen.

55207616042f.en: Harry made a wet gagging sound. His whole upper body jumped forward, forcing him to sit up on the table. His hands held his mouth shut tight as new waves of gags visibly surged from deep in his belly, making his whole body cringe. As he breathed quickly through his nose, his skin grew pale and his dilated pupils looked at Eori, seemingly seeking salvation.
55207616042f.t: Harry mengeluarkan bunyi mual yang basah. Seluruh tubuh bagian atasnya melompat ke depan, memaksanya duduk di atas meja. Tangannya menutup mulutnya rapat-rapat saat gelombang-gelombang mual baru terlihat menyembur dari dalam perutnya, membuat seluruh tubuhnya meringis. Saat ia bernapas cepat lewat hidungnya, kulitnya memucat dan pupilnya yang membesar memandang Eori, tampaknya mencari keselamatan.

56d3fc174bad.en: “I don’t know what the flu is—use other words.” Eori mixed the bowl, preparing another spoon of equal portions. Another strange word for the list—
56d3fc174bad.t: “Aku tidak tahu flu itu apa—pakai kata lain.” Eori mengaduk mangkuk itu, menyiapkan satu sendok lagi dengan porsi yang sama. Satu lagi kata aneh untuk daftar—

5ef1e6814396.en: A short sigh came from Eori, her hands busy looking for hidden jars amongst the macabre wall. “An amphibian. Jumps around on its hind legs. Lives and breeds in ponds.”
5ef1e6814396.t: Helaan napas singkat keluar dari Eori, tangannya sibuk mencari toples-toples tersembunyi di antara dinding mengerikan itu. “Amfibi. Melompat-lompat dengan kaki belakangnya. Hidup dan berkembang biak di kolam.”

60866e80b0f0.en: Doing so, Harry opened his mouth and filled his lungs with a large breath, making a slight wheezing sound. He then held his breath, slipping out a cough here and there as he looked towards Eori. His eyes seemed unsure, but his unfurrowed brow did not appear as if he would refuse any orders.
60866e80b0f0.t: Melakukannya, Harry membuka mulutnya dan mengisi paru-parunya dengan tarikan napas besar, menimbulkan bunyi mengi pelan. Ia lalu menahan napasnya, sesekali terbatuk sambil memandang ke arah Eori. Matanya tampak ragu, tetapi alisnya yang tidak berkerut tidak tampak seolah ia akan menolak perintah apa pun.

618094968744.en: Another quick response from Eori ensued as she was still perusing through the jars, “Fish with a big snout. Uses electricity to kill its prey. Its skin is tougher than normal fish skin, including being able to dissipate elemental energy—or rather, absorb it like a shield.”
618094968744.t: Jawaban cepat lain dari Eori menyusul sambil masih memeriksa toples-toples itu, “Ikan dengan moncong besar. Memakai listrik untuk membunuh mangsanya. Kulitnya lebih keras daripada kulit ikan biasa, termasuk mampu menghamburkan energi elemental—atau lebih tepatnya, menyerapnya seperti perisai.”

6b83c2b2bb4b.en: Eori covered Harry’s mouth after feeding him four spoonfuls of an experimental red nari gel mixed only with lakata and worm skin blue carapace. She couldn’t stop smiling, seeing the grains of sand in the tiny timehunk sandglass counting away the time far past the previous baseline. I can’t believe I never thought of using culuim skin and lakata!
6b83c2b2bb4b.t: Eori menutup mulut Harry setelah menyuapinya empat sendok nari gel merah eksperimental yang hanya dicampur lakata dan kulit cacing bercangkang biru. Ia tidak bisa berhenti tersenyum, melihat butiran pasir di jam pasir timehunk mungil itu menghitung waktu jauh melampaui kondisi dasar sebelumnya. Aku tidak percaya aku tidak pernah terpikir memakai kulit culuim dan lakata!

6dca675f571b.en: “SHIT!” Eori put the bowl aside, grabbed the same bluish nari gel called Nari Refresher, and emptied the bottle down Harry’s gullet.
6dca675f571b.t: “SIAL!” Eori menyingkirkan mangkuk itu, mengambil nari gel kebiruan yang sama bernama Nari Refresher, dan mengosongkan botolnya ke kerongkongan Harry.

739dfae4f3f6.en: An incomprehensible babble came out of Harry, who was now taking shallow breaths that were not even close to being as quick as a pant. He murmured something incoherent again, moving his shackled hand towards Eori.
739dfae4f3f6.t: Ocehan yang tidak bisa dipahami keluar dari Harry, yang kini mengambil napas dangkal yang bahkan tidak mendekati secepat terengah-engah. Ia bergumam sesuatu yang tidak jelas lagi, menggerakkan tangannya yang dibelenggu ke arah Eori.

763eeb23d585.en: Harry’s spasms kept coming and going in cycles, with each cycle looking weaker than before. “Arjun yg—” Harry spoke with a limp jaw, sounding like he was speaking in tongues—or probably he was entirely out of it.
763eeb23d585.t: Kejang-kejang Harry terus datang dan pergi dalam siklus, dengan setiap siklus tampak lebih lemah dari sebelumnya. “Arjun yg—” kata Harry dengan rahang terkulai, terdengar seolah sedang berbicara dalam bahasa roh—atau mungkin ia sepenuhnya tidak sadar.

77ad9cf4da00.en: Rubbing himself against the table and his shackled hands throughout his body, Harry let out an anguished cry. “Itching! Itching! So—fucking itchy!” Harry could not stop scratching himself like a heroin addict. His whole skin was reddening like he had suddenly developed eczema—or had the pleasure of rubbing himself in poison ivy.
77ad9cf4da00.t: Menggosok-gosokkan tubuhnya ke meja dan tangannya yang dibelenggu ke seluruh tubuhnya, Harry mengeluarkan jeritan tersiksa. “Gatal! Gatal! Gatal—banget, bangsat!” Harry tidak bisa berhenti menggaruk dirinya seperti pecandu heroin. Seluruh kulitnya memerah seolah ia tiba-tiba terkena eksim—atau mendapat kehormatan menggosokkan dirinya ke tanaman beracun.

7802ddc15b5f.en: “Can—can I ask about barina?” Harry’s voice grew inwards, handing the journal back to Eori with both hands as he didn’t seem to dare bother her for too long.
7802ddc15b5f.t: “Bo—bolehkah aku tanya soal barina?” Suara Harry semakin ke dalam, menyerahkan jurnal itu kembali kepada Eori dengan kedua tangan karena ia tampaknya tidak berani mengganggunya terlalu lama.

79a39b6eb360.en: “I—like—feverish? Or when you suddenly exercise too much?” Harry coughed, but nothing came up. It sounded odd, like he had bronchitis. “My lungs feel weird. Like I just ripped a fat bong—” He coughed again, but this time looking to be straining so much his face was flushed red. Scratching his head amongst the coughs, he seemed to think out loud, “Wait—did I ever smoke?”
79a39b6eb360.t: “Aku—seperti—demam? Atau saat kau tiba-tiba olahraga terlalu banyak?” Harry terbatuk, tetapi tidak ada yang keluar. Bunyinya aneh, seolah ia terkena bronkitis. “Paru-paruku terasa aneh. Seperti baru mengisap bong besar—” Ia terbatuk lagi, tetapi kali ini tampak mengejan begitu keras sampai wajahnya memerah. Menggaruk kepalanya di sela-sela batuk, ia tampak berpikir keras, “Tunggu—apa aku pernah merokok?”

7a9e37e17fd6.en: In reality, her journal had in-depth notes about experiments she had planned for years, even the order in which she wanted to do them. Her journal was opened on experiment forty-one, titled No Breath Improvements. Eori, scratching her underboob, compared the resources written down with the myriad of curated macabre selection of jars around her. Her eyes searched for lakata, fihi gills, and barina lungs. Gabiro just kept the bare minimum in stock—is that how he researched? Just writing away hypotheticals? Eori shook her head, grabbing a jar filled with blackish water with two lines written on top of the cork. The first line stated Lakata, while the second was 1038 A.G. Adrian 84th. Eori cleaned off the bits of dust from the top with a nearby towel. None of these jars were produced this year. Eori looked around her, seeing most jars still filled to the brim with whatever they contained. Why was Gabiro fucking bothering storing all of these if he specialized in soul and ancient interfaces? Or was Mother expecting this to happen last year?
7a9e37e17fd6.t: Kenyataannya, jurnalnya berisi catatan mendalam tentang eksperimen-eksperimen yang sudah ia rencanakan selama bertahun-tahun, bahkan urutan ia ingin melakukannya. Jurnalnya terbuka di eksperimen empat puluh satu, berjudul No Breath Improvements. Eori, menggaruk bagian bawah payudaranya, membandingkan bahan-bahan yang tertulis dengan beragam pilihan toples mengerikan yang terkurasi di sekitarnya. Matanya mencari lakata, insang fihi, dan paru-paru barina. Gabiro hanya menyimpan stok seminimal mungkin—apa begitu caranya meneliti? Cuma menulis-nulis hipotesis? Eori menggeleng, mengambil sebuah toples berisi air kehitaman dengan dua baris tulisan di atas sumbatnya. Baris pertama bertuliskan Lakata, sedangkan yang kedua 84 Adrian 1038 A.G. Eori membersihkan sedikit debu dari atasnya dengan handuk di dekatnya. Tidak ada satu pun toples ini yang dibuat tahun ini. Eori memandang sekelilingnya, melihat sebagian besar toples masih terisi penuh dengan apa pun isinya. Kenapa Gabiro repot-repot menyimpan semua ini, bangsat, kalau dia berspesialisasi di bidang jiwa dan antarmuka kuno? Atau apa Ibu sudah menduga ini akan terjadi tahun lalu?

8607c959bba0.en: Eori, the third princess of Sanbi, was in a Neferteri-sponsored hideout that served as a scientific lab. The nearest village, called Dead Fish, was at least thirty minutes’ walking or about ten minutes by carriage if you somehow knew where you were going. The main roads, or more precisely, the backroads around, were rough too, requiring travelers to be on the ready for wild animals—and the rare bandit that would pass by. The village itself was far off to the northeast of Sanbi Kingdom, on a peninsula that would take most of the day to get to—basically, the perfect place to do something surreptitiously while not being totally cut off from civilization. In her hands, a pinkish journal with a small metal Sanbi decoration hanging off it gave the impression to a passerby that Eori, in comfy pajamas with her loose purple hair, was reading off her diary, getting high off her deliriously written love notes.
8607c959bba0.t: Eori, putri ketiga Sanbi, berada di sebuah tempat persembunyian yang disponsori Neferteri yang berfungsi sebagai laboratorium ilmiah. Desa terdekat, bernama Dead Fish, setidaknya tiga puluh menit berjalan kaki atau sekitar sepuluh menit dengan kereta kalau kamu entah bagaimana tahu ke mana harus pergi. Jalan-jalan utama, atau lebih tepatnya, jalan-jalan belakang di sekitarnya, juga kasar, mengharuskan para pelancong siap menghadapi hewan liar—dan bandit langka yang kadang lewat. Desa itu sendiri berada jauh di timur laut Kerajaan Sanbi, di sebuah semenanjung yang butuh hampir seharian untuk dicapai—pada dasarnya, tempat yang sempurna untuk melakukan sesuatu secara diam-diam tanpa benar-benar terputus dari peradaban. Di tangannya, sebuah jurnal merah muda dengan hiasan logam Sanbi kecil yang menggantung darinya memberi kesan kepada orang yang lewat bahwa Eori, dengan piyama nyaman dan rambut ungu yang tergerai, sedang membaca buku hariannya, teler oleh catatan-catatan cinta yang ditulisnya dengan mengigau.

878e106127d9.en: “Hold your breath.” Eori held her hand tightly around Harry’s wrist. This seems slightly above resting, although—likely nominal, given how much he’s coughing. She flipped a small sandglass resting by him.
878e106127d9.t: “Tahan napasmu.” Eori memegang erat pergelangan tangan Harry. Ini tampak sedikit di atas kondisi istirahat, walaupun—mungkin masih normal, mengingat betapa banyak dia batuk. Ia membalik jam pasir kecil yang terletak di dekatnya.

89cb07b014cc.en: “What’s that?” Eori’s eyes now glanced around for barina skin along the macabre-looking jars. Her hands sprung into action, helping on the lookout. It didn’t help the matter that the jar her eyes hunted could be in different forms. Skins by themselves or mixed with other barina parts. For fuck’s sake! Who was the retarded who came up with the idea of writing the labels on the top? Her brain brought up memories of all the different barina skin colors and patterns she had seen before, which could also change depending on where they were harvested.
89cb07b014cc.t: “Apa itu?” Mata Eori kini melirik ke sekeliling mencari kulit barina di antara toples-toples yang tampak mengerikan. Tangannya bergerak cepat, membantu mencari. Tidak membantu juga bahwa toples yang diburu matanya bisa dalam berbagai bentuk. Kulit saja atau dicampur dengan bagian barina lainnya. Demi apa pun, bangsat! Siapa si idiot yang punya ide menulis labelnya di atas? Otaknya memunculkan ingatan tentang semua warna dan pola kulit barina berbeda yang pernah ia lihat sebelumnya, yang juga bisa berubah tergantung di mana barina itu dipanen.

8a36c12d7f10.en: Speaking softly, Harry replied, “I-I guess like a frog? Then—can—can I ask why—why not use its skin rather than lungs?”
8a36c12d7f10.t: Berbicara pelan, Harry menjawab, “A-aku kira seperti katak? Lalu—bo—bolehkah aku tanya kenapa—kenapa tidak memakai kulitnya saja alih-alih paru-parunya?”

8ae9bdae8330.en: “What are you feeling?” Eori poked Harry in the neck, trying to feel a bump above the shoulders, but her fingers just felt a tensed-up superficial muscle instead—or what gym buffs refer to as the sternocleidomastoid.
8ae9bdae8330.t: “Apa yang kau rasakan?” Eori menyodok leher Harry, mencoba merasakan tonjolan di atas bahu, tetapi jari-jarinya hanya merasakan otot permukaan yang menegang—atau yang disebut para penggila gym sebagai sternokleidomastoid.

93e99d915986.en: Harry rolled his eyes back, going limp and unresponsive; he didn’t even flinch or fight the urge to breathe—if he even had it. It looked like a relatively peaceful, voluntary action on his part to pass out on demand.
93e99d915986.t: Mata Harry berputar ke belakang, terkulai lemas dan tidak merespons; ia bahkan tidak tersentak atau melawan dorongan untuk bernapas—kalau ia memang punya dorongan itu. Tampak seperti tindakan yang relatif damai dan sukarela darinya untuk pingsan sesuai permintaan.

9a38d7cbf4f8.en: Vol 2 Chapter V subchapter 1: the purple-haired woman looks worried beside Harry, who lies with red, raw-looking skin next to an hourglass.
9a38d7cbf4f8.t: Jilid 2 Bab V subbab 1: wanita berambut ungu tampak cemas di samping Harry, yang berbaring dengan kulit merah yang tampak mentah di samping jam pasir.

9b794ef876b4.en: Eori placed the bowl aside, observing the lack of movement in Harry’s chest again. “Close your mouth and breathe through your nose! Your breathing reflex has stopped—get your hand out of there!” Eori snappily said, shoving Harry’s hand away from his neck.
9b794ef876b4.t: Eori menyingkirkan mangkuk itu, mengamati kembali tidak bergeraknya dada Harry. “Tutup mulutmu dan bernapaslah lewat hidung! Refleks bernapasmu sudah berhenti—keluarkan tanganmu dari situ!” kata Eori dengan ketus, menepis tangan Harry dari lehernya.

a2a9b826b9ac.en: Each side of Harry’s neck developed a sizeable bony plate that looked to protect something within, only revealing a deep cut around its edges—just like the operculum of a fish gill.
a2a9b826b9ac.t: Masing-masing sisi leher Harry mengembangkan pelat tulang yang cukup besar yang tampak melindungi sesuatu di dalamnya, hanya memperlihatkan sayatan dalam di sekeliling tepinya—persis seperti tutup insang ikan.

a94778d9d1be.en: This is what it means to be a scientist! Eori waved her journal towards Harry from across the room. “Today, we’re researching forty-one. No breath. Markets only sell the same variant nowadays, so either it is the best variant or they monopolize the market with shit tactics. I’m going to find out which one is true.”
a94778d9d1be.t: Inilah artinya menjadi ilmuwan! Eori mengacungkan jurnalnya ke arah Harry dari seberang ruangan. “Hari ini, kita meneliti empat puluh satu. No breath. Pasar-pasar sekarang hanya menjual varian yang sama, jadi entah itu memang varian terbaik atau mereka memonopoli pasar dengan taktik busuk. Aku akan mencari tahu mana yang benar.”

afa70d1a3b0f.en: Lowering his shackled hands, Harry kept making small, muffled sounds that slipped through Eori’s hand while he still shivered away.
afa70d1a3b0f.t: Menurunkan tangannya yang dibelenggu, Harry terus mengeluarkan bunyi-bunyi kecil teredam yang lolos melalui tangan Eori sementara ia masih menggigil.

b1994f92f63f.en: Harry made a wet grunt, drawing a deep breath that sounded wheezy. He coughed like a chain smoker, bringing up what appeared to be a thick spit from his lungs. “I’m sorry—I tried to speak—”
b1994f92f63f.t: Harry mendengus basah, menarik napas dalam yang terdengar mengi. Ia terbatuk seperti perokok berat, mengeluarkan sesuatu yang tampak seperti ludah kental dari paru-parunya. “Maaf—aku mencoba bicara—”

b372028a3e48.en: “I thought maybe—maybe you can use the skin-breathing ability of fro—barina!” Harry kept his hands up.
b372028a3e48.t: “Kukira mungkin—mungkin kau bisa memakai kemampuan bernapas lewat kulit dari kat—barina!” Harry tetap mengangkat tangannya.

b508ce6fe550.en: I cannot believe other scientists haven’t figured this out. At this rate, I will be well-known in a matter of weeks! Eori kept smiling, looking at Harry with a glimmer in her eyes as he was still shifting about. C’mon already! She watched the remaining grains of sand stubbornly plopping into the glass bulb below slowly. If I reach through the entire tiny hunk, I need to create a uniform for my debut as a scientist! Her impatient mind filled the passing time with a familiar voice that echoed from deep within. In exchange, you will outdo yourself to be a far better queen than your other sisters. It was her mother’s voice, the queen of Sanbi. She squeezed Harry’s mouth tighter as hearing her voice immediately chipped away at the fun she was having. A brew of emotions made her want to punch someone’s throat, but doing so would screw up her experiment.
b508ce6fe550.t: Aku tidak percaya ilmuwan lain belum memahami ini. Dengan laju seperti ini, aku akan terkenal dalam hitungan minggu! Eori terus tersenyum, memandang Harry dengan kilau di matanya saat ia masih menggeliat. Ayolah! Ia memperhatikan sisa butiran pasir yang dengan keras kepala jatuh perlahan ke bola kaca di bawah. Kalau aku berhasil melewati satu timehunk mungil penuh, aku harus membuat seragam untuk debutku sebagai ilmuwan! Pikirannya yang tidak sabar mengisi waktu yang berlalu dengan suara familier yang menggema dari dalam. Sebagai gantinya, kamu akan melampaui dirimu sendiri untuk menjadi ratu yang jauh lebih baik daripada saudari-saudarimu yang lain. Itu suara ibunya, ratu Sanbi. Ia meremas mulut Harry lebih erat karena mendengar suara itu langsung mengikis kesenangan yang sedang ia nikmati. Campuran emosi membuatnya ingin meninju tenggorokan seseorang, tetapi melakukannya akan mengacaukan eksperimennya.

b51602be582a.en: Eori observed Harry’s chest beginning to move slowly on its own. Breathing reflex is still there, so he is genuinely baseline to No Breath Tier I. Eori slapped Harry hard in the face. “Wake up already!”
b51602be582a.t: Eori mengamati dada Harry mulai bergerak perlahan dengan sendirinya. Refleks bernapas masih ada, jadi dia benar-benar sesuai dasar untuk No Breath Tier I. Eori menampar keras wajah Harry. “Bangun!”

b52acdb0249f.en: Harry now seemed to trend towards a half-conscious, half-unconscious state. His eyelids were going from closed to half-opened, then back to shut, as his irises seemed unresponsive.
b52acdb0249f.t: Harry kini tampaknya cenderung ke keadaan setengah sadar, setengah tidak sadar. Kelopak matanya bergerak dari tertutup ke setengah terbuka, lalu kembali tertutup, sementara irisnya tampak tidak merespons.

b967016eaa85.en: With a slight nod, Harry’s teary bloodshoot eyes kept blinking away, seemingly trying to push out the irritating thick slime permeating from all over his wormy skin around his eyes. His whole body shivered enough to make the shackles in his hand and feet rustle against the table soaked in slime, while the saggy bluish skin hanging from his back looked like a painted ballsack sagging on a muggy summer day.
b967016eaa85.t: Dengan anggukan kecil, mata Harry yang berlinang dan merah terus berkedip, tampaknya berusaha mendorong keluar lendir kental yang menjengkelkan yang merembes dari seluruh kulitnya yang seperti cacing di sekitar matanya. Seluruh tubuhnya menggigil cukup keras untuk membuat belenggu di tangan dan kakinya berkerincing di meja yang basah oleh lendir, sementara kulit kebiruan yang kendur yang menggantung dari punggungnya tampak seperti kantong peler yang dicat yang mengendur di hari musim panas yang gerah.

ba51711ccf9a.en: “Fucking breathe quickly!” Eori approached closer, slapping Harry in the face. “I don’t want to waste a revival!” She hit him harder.
ba51711ccf9a.t: “Bernapas cepat, bangsat!” Eori mendekat, menampar wajah Harry. “Aku tidak mau membuang satu penghidupan kembali!” Ia memukulnya lebih keras.

bbaa952b1118.en: Eori smiled viciously again, standing up and looking at her either passed-out or pretty dead-looking worm-skin lab soreno. Shit!
bbaa952b1118.t: Eori tersenyum keji lagi, berdiri dan memandang soreno percobaannya yang berkulit cacing, yang entah pingsan atau tampak cukup mati. Sial!

c16afd4caf53.en: Eori, the third princess of Sanbi, was in a Neferteri-sponsored hideout that served as a scientific lab.
c16afd4caf53.t: Eori, putri ketiga Sanbi, berada di sebuah tempat persembunyian yang disponsori Neferteri yang berfungsi sebagai laboratorium ilmiah.

c6984ac9ddf3.en: Could that be an ability of his? Something akin to a new interface that tampers with other interfaces? Eori dumped the protein-heavy blue-carapace worm medallion breakfast cereal down his gullet. A bubbly feeling rushed through her body as her eyes attentively looked at every inch of his body. She could hear Harry trying to chew the raw, rubbery skin. “Dammit! I told you already to swallow it!” She held his mouth until he forced a gulp—like feeding a pill to a dog.
c6984ac9ddf3.t: Mungkinkah itu kemampuannya? Sesuatu yang mirip antarmuka baru yang mengutak-atik antarmuka lain? Eori menuangkan sereal sarapan berupa potongan cacing bercangkang biru yang kaya protein itu ke kerongkongan Harry. Perasaan meletup-letup mengalir di tubuhnya saat matanya dengan cermat memandangi setiap inci tubuh Harry. Ia bisa mendengar Harry mencoba mengunyah kulit mentah yang kenyal itu. “Sialan! Sudah kubilang telan saja!” Ia menahan mulut Harry sampai ia memaksakan satu tegukan—seperti memberi pil kepada anjing.

c6e3b9ef8dae.en: A groggy Harry half-opened his eyes, twitching around as he stopped breathing again.
c6e3b9ef8dae.t: Harry yang linglung setengah membuka matanya, berkedut ke sana kemari saat ia berhenti bernapas lagi.

c810b1a042b7.en: Harry shook his head and opened his mouth like a baby bird waiting to be fed. His eyes closed again, seemingly ready to taste-test another exquisite nari gel.
c810b1a042b7.t: Harry menggeleng dan membuka mulutnya seperti anak burung yang menunggu disuapi. Matanya terpejam lagi, tampaknya siap mencicipi satu lagi nari gel yang istimewa.

cbb4ac465d6c.en: *Exploring nari gels is still far more interesting—*Eori used a spoon to grab an equal amount of lakata, fihi gills, and barina lungs from the serving bowl in her hand, then dumped it all down on Harry’s wide-open mouth. “Don’t chew it! Just swallow it already!”
cbb4ac465d6c.t: *Menjelajahi nari gel tetap jauh lebih menarik—*Eori memakai sendok untuk mengambil lakata, insang fihi, dan paru-paru barina dalam jumlah yang sama dari mangkuk saji di tangannya, lalu menuangkan semuanya ke mulut Harry yang terbuka lebar. “Jangan dikunyah! Telan saja!”

cde222b46bf1.en: “Kinda—I think.” Harry came face-to-face with the jar, squinting his eyes to look deep into it. “Not sure if they were that big and colorful, though—”
cde222b46bf1.t: “Agak—kurasa.” Harry berhadapan muka dengan toples itu, menyipitkan matanya untuk melihat dalam-dalam ke dalamnya. “Tapi tidak yakin apa sebesar dan seberwarna itu—”

ce7d862077ab.en: Cold sweat ran down his forehead. With a nod and a few gulps, Harry began to relax once again, lying back down. However, the relaxation this time didn’t last long—he groaned in pain, grasping his neck. The groan then turned into choking-like noises as if a ghost were strangling him.
ce7d862077ab.t: Keringat dingin mengalir di dahinya. Dengan anggukan dan beberapa tegukan, Harry mulai santai lagi, berbaring kembali. Namun, kali ini rasa santai itu tidak bertahan lama—ia mengerang kesakitan, mencengkeram lehernya. Erangan itu lalu berubah menjadi bunyi seperti tercekik seolah hantu sedang mencekiknya.

d0a41dcb7d0a.en: “That’s expected. What else did you feel?” Eori now picked up the second serving bowl, containing nothing but red nari gel and worm medallions in different colors—it had a breakfast cereal vibe, perhaps a Halloween-themed one, as the blood-red liquid was totally off-putting. I’m fucking finally on the actual forerunning of science!
d0a41dcb7d0a.t: “Itu sudah diduga. Apa lagi yang kau rasakan?” Eori kini mengambil mangkuk saji kedua, yang hanya berisi nari gel merah dan potongan-potongan cacing berbentuk medali berbagai warna—punya aura sereal sarapan, mungkin yang bertema Halloween, karena cairan merah darah itu benar-benar tidak menggugah selera. Akhirnya aku benar-benar berada di garis terdepan ilmu pengetahuan, bangsat!

dcf6076342a0.en: The sensitivity by itself is already an excellent Nari Gel opportunity! A few research papers too! Eori fed a fourth spoon, containing a purple-carapace worm medallion alongside the usual bloody red gel. “This is the last one!”
dcf6076342a0.t: Sensitivitasnya saja sudah merupakan peluang Nari Gel yang luar biasa! Beberapa makalah penelitian juga! Eori menyuapkan sendok keempat, berisi potongan cacing bercangkang ungu bersama gel merah darah yang biasa. “Ini yang terakhir!”

dd89d9068841.en: *That makes sense. Won’t sell well in Gandew then—*Eori grabbed a vial of black honey on her way to the sink, popped the cork, and poured it into a cup. Or something I can research into how to counteract.
dd89d9068841.t: *Masuk akal. Berarti tidak akan laku di Gandew—*Eori mengambil sebotol kecil madu hitam dalam perjalanannya ke wastafel, membuka sumbatnya, dan menuangkannya ke cangkir. Atau sesuatu yang bisa kuteliti cara menangkalnya.

de6d72866e42.en: “I remember that—like—frogs breathe through the skin and lungs. I feel like I learned it while I was young—like in school?” Harry lowered his shackled hands and stood still, tensed up as he looked down at Eori’s feet—perhaps still expecting a beating. “Just like earthworms—”
de6d72866e42.t: “Aku ingat bahwa—misalnya—katak bernapas lewat kulit dan paru-paru. Aku merasa aku mempelajarinya waktu masih kecil—seperti di sekolah?” Harry menurunkan tangannya yang dibelenggu dan berdiri diam, tegang sambil memandang ke bawah ke kaki Eori—mungkin masih mengira akan dipukuli. “Sama seperti cacing tanah—”

dec0d02819b9.en: With a gagless gulp, Harry began making loud, wet gurgles as his hands held his neck, trying to scratch it. Saliva bubbles poured from the sides of his mouth as he began coughing up even more spit.
dec0d02819b9.t: Dengan tegukan tanpa mual, Harry mulai mengeluarkan bunyi deguk basah yang keras sementara tangannya memegangi lehernya, mencoba menggaruknya. Gelembung-gelembung air liur mengalir dari sudut-sudut mulutnya saat ia mulai membatukkan lebih banyak ludah.

df3db29f69d6.en: “I know you can’t talk! I need to revert it first.” Eori reached out to a bluish nari gel close to Harry named Nari Refresher and spoon-fed two hearty servings to him.
df3db29f69d6.t: “Aku tahu kau tidak bisa bicara! Aku harus mengembalikannya dulu.” Eori meraih nari gel kebiruan di dekat Harry yang bernama Nari Refresher dan menyuapinya dua porsi besar.

e3b2e67c9ae1.en: “Stop fighting it. It will only take longer and make you weaker.” Eori watched Harry fight with what appeared to be another round of a ghost trying to choke him out.
e3b2e67c9ae1.t: “Berhenti melawannya. Itu cuma akan makan waktu lebih lama dan membuatmu lebih lemah.” Eori memperhatikan Harry melawan apa yang tampak seperti satu ronde lagi hantu yang berusaha mencekiknya.

ee5743ea1031.en: “My neck felt weird. Like the sides moved when you moved my mouth—like—like they were open?” Harry moved his shackled hands to feel his neck, now looking like a plain neck. “Even breathing was weird. Can—can I ask if that was actually a gill?”
ee5743ea1031.t: “Leherku terasa aneh. Seperti sisi-sisinya bergerak saat kau menggerakkan mulutku—seperti—seperti terbuka?” Harry menggerakkan tangannya yang dibelenggu untuk meraba lehernya, yang kini tampak seperti leher biasa. “Bahkan bernapas juga terasa aneh. Bo—bolehkah aku tanya apa itu benar-benar insang?”

f08b43aba22b.en: In an apparent response to Eori’s hand pressing his mouth down, Harry’s shifting about grew worse with a muffled squeal trying to slip out from her tight grip. His own hands harshly danced in the air, half-heartedly reaching out to slap away Eori’s hand, but failed to do so, or perhaps avoided doing so, when his bloodshot wide eyes stared at her smile turning upside down.
f08b43aba22b.t: Tampaknya sebagai respons terhadap tangan Eori yang menekan mulutnya, gerakan Harry semakin parah dengan pekikan teredam yang berusaha lolos dari cengkeramannya yang erat. Tangannya sendiri menari-nari kasar di udara, setengah hati berusaha menepis tangan Eori, tetapi gagal melakukannya, atau mungkin menghindari melakukannya, saat matanya yang merah dan terbelalak menatap senyum Eori yang berubah terbalik.

f4ee358213af.en: Eori felt his hand half-punch, half-slap her clitoris as a shocking feeling made her entire body flinch, pushing her hips to swing backward, away from his reach. “Fuck off! Not right now!” She slapped his hands away, then shoved another spoonful from the serving bowl down on Harry’s gullet, nearly deep-throating him in the process.
f4ee358213af.t: Eori merasakan tangannya setengah meninju, setengah menampar klitorisnya saat perasaan mengejutkan membuat seluruh tubuhnya tersentak, mendorong pinggulnya berayun ke belakang, menjauh dari jangkauannya. “Persetan! Jangan sekarang!” Ia menepis tangan Harry, lalu menjejalkan satu sendok lagi dari mangkuk saji ke kerongkongan Harry, hampir menyodok tenggorokannya dalam-dalam dalam prosesnya.

f746b533c7e9.en: “We need to do another round with just the worm skin and lakata!” Eori bit her lips as excitement tickled her scientific brain with a plethora of possibilities of what could happen. “Not bad, Harry!”
f746b533c7e9.t: “Kita harus melakukan satu ronde lagi hanya dengan kulit cacing dan lakata!” Eori menggigit bibirnya saat kegembiraan menggelitik otak ilmiahnya dengan berbagai kemungkinan tentang apa yang bisa terjadi. “Lumayan, Harry!”

f9a15e28c110.en: The gill-like structure in his neck closed tightly, but it wasn’t completely sealed. Another wet gurgle came out of him after he drew a breath. His shackled hands pointed at his neck.
f9a15e28c110.t: Struktur mirip insang di lehernya menutup rapat, tetapi tidak sepenuhnya tersegel. Deguk basah lain keluar darinya setelah ia menarik napas. Tangannya yang dibelenggu menunjuk lehernya.

fb03ad408bac.en: Whatever Gabiro did, it’s not affecting the baseline. Still, what is the connection between Fake Body and the inability to repro his body hair? Eori looked back at the spoon she was holding. “Anything else?”
fb03ad408bac.t: Apa pun yang dilakukan Gabiro, itu tidak memengaruhi kondisi dasarnya. Tetap saja, apa hubungan antara Fake Body dan ketidakmampuan mereproduksi bulu tubuhnya? Eori kembali memandang sendok yang ia pegang. “Ada lagi?”

fb82e3a8457e.en: Harry’s skin grew wavy like an earthworm and even more slimy. Slime poured over his eyes, nose, mouth, and ears. He kept spitting the slime away, clearing his nose and spitting even more, letting gargled words out, “I-ca-t-s-e!” He slowly moved his hands towards his eyes. “I’m—c-d! Ev-h-ig—s-ni-tie—” His voice was breaking up amidst wet, slimy choking sounds.
fb82e3a8457e.t: Kulit Harry menjadi bergelombang seperti cacing tanah dan semakin berlendir. Lendir mengalir menutupi mata, hidung, mulut, dan telinganya. Ia terus meludahkan lendir itu, membersihkan hidungnya dan meludah lebih banyak lagi, mengeluarkan kata-kata yang berdeguk, “A-tak-bi-a-li-hat!” Ia perlahan menggerakkan tangannya ke arah matanya. “A-u—di-gin! Se-mu-a—sen-si-tif—” Suaranya terputus-putus di tengah bunyi tercekik yang basah dan berlendir.

fbd19aac739c.en: Harry’s skin grew even wavier, while the skin in his back grew baggier and purple-colored, mimicking rather close the carapace of the culuim. A groan came out of him as he now seemed immobile. He opened his mouth, seeking air like a dying fish. A bubble of slime formed then popped—apparently just like his conscience as he went limp again.
fbd19aac739c.t: Kulit Harry semakin bergelombang, sementara kulit di punggungnya semakin kendur dan berwarna ungu, cukup mirip meniru cangkang culuim. Erangan keluar darinya saat ia kini tampak tak bisa bergerak. Ia membuka mulutnya, mencari udara seperti ikan sekarat. Sebuah gelembung lendir terbentuk lalu pecah—tampaknya persis seperti kesadarannya saat ia terkulai lemas lagi.

fe885dbb79f5.en: Vol 2 Chapter IV subchapter 6: Harry, bound and in pain, as the purple-haired woman reaches toward him with a dish of red gel.
fe885dbb79f5.t: Jilid 2 Bab IV subbab 6: Harry, terikat dan kesakitan, sementara wanita berambut ungu mengulurkan tangan ke arahnya dengan sepiring gel merah.

ff37aecc0b59.en: Harry blinked with an open stare from the corner of his eyes towards Eori. He tried to say something, but only a wet gurgle came through.
ff37aecc0b59.t: Harry berkedip dengan tatapan terbuka dari sudut matanya ke arah Eori. Ia mencoba mengatakan sesuatu, tetapi hanya bunyi deguk basah yang keluar.
